# Settlement amounts are fractional again

July 2026. Supersedes `2026-02-settlement-amount-units.md`.

Our largest partner now requires fractional currency amounts instead of whole
units, so the whole-unit rule is no longer a rule every partner shares. As the
February note predicted, once one partner needed fractional amounts the
whole-unit conversion stopped being a property of the adapter.

Rather than keep a per-partner branch (whole units for some, cents for
others), the adapter now converts every order to a fractional currency amount
(`amount_cents / 100`, using `Decimal` to avoid float rounding error). Whole
amounts are just fractional amounts with a zero remainder, so this is a strict
generalization: no partner that accepted whole units should reject a
fractional value with `.00`.

If a partner is later found that truly cannot accept a fractional amount,
that becomes a per-partner exception again, not a reason to revert this
default.
